summary:
harness now imports only itself and aicore and passes standalone. run/worker takes selectors from aicore.provider.models; run/task_paths finds the planner via PLANNER_ROOT, SKM_TASK_ROOT (deprecated), PLANNER_PLAN_PY or PATH, with no neighbour or monorepo step. The instruction catalog is 1.8.0 with scopes[].targets as data and SCOPES, TARGETS and CATALOG_VERSION computed from it (36 generated files byte-identical, lock refreshed). The Cursor routing rule is built from the aicore model catalog. The hooks maind.sh, plan-check.sh, run-report.py and plan-regen.py use SKM_

_BIN/ROOT/PATH ladders. Wrappers have no MONOREPO_ROOT. Layout independence: package files resolve from the package root, reviewroles reads the skiller index via SKM_SKILLER_ROOT or PATH, validate.sh skips hub gates without a hub. Added tests/test_boundary.py, tests/test_hook_partners.py and tests/test_instruction_catalog_data.py. Config, baseline and CHANGELOG updated. Targeted runs: full harness suite in hub mode with partner env (774 tests OK) and in a standalone copy (OK), harness validate.sh in a standalone copy (OK), full maind suite (695 OK), golden.py check, ecosystem-units check and render --check, scripts/test-*.py loop, instruction/cursor-rule/execpolicy/reviewroles checks in the hub.
